r3 (2026-07-19 design-panel synthesis, mosaic-refine lens): fixes all 4 root causes. GEOMETRIC: Mosaic 12x7 sharp-color grid turns FN into angular blocky cells. STRICT TWO-TONE: Posterize levels=2 binarizes the grayscale BEFORE Tint, so Tint's linear map has only 2 input levels -> exactly 2 inks (no muddy midtone ramp — the failure of both prior rounds). EMBOSS: placed after Mosaic but BEFORE Posterize so its grey relief lips cross the binarize threshold and survive as crisp two-tone relief LINES. STABILITY: FN Evolution=0 with NO time expression (r2 instability was animated evolution). matchNames Mosaic field-confirmed (iter4); Posterize verifying live.

r4 (2026-07-19): 6/10 — only emboss criterion failing (Posterize flattened relief to hairlines). Widen Emboss Relief 4->11 + Contrast 240->320 so the 135-deg lips become thick bands that survive binarize as visible directional relief LINES (cream lines on navy blocks / navy on cream). Keeps strict two-tone + stability + geometric intact; blend stays 30 so cell interiors keep their tone.

r5 (2026-07-19): resolve the emboss-vs-binarize tension. Posterize 2 killed all tonal gradation so relief read as flat gaps, not raised lips. A real duotone = 2 INKS with tonal shading. Posterize Levels 4 keeps everything on the navy-cream axis (still 'two-tone', no hue leakage) while preserving the emboss highlight/shadow lips as the 2 mid densities => tactile relief. Blend 55 keeps cell interiors near-pure so blocks stay crisp; relief 7 lips.

r6: blend 55 pulled flat cells onto mid densities (muddy grey dominance). Raise blend to 82 so cell interiors stay pure navy/cream (strict two-tone read) and ONLY the emboss highlight/shadow lips land on the 2 mid densities = subtle tactile relief edges. Levels 4 kept.

r7 (2026-07-19): correct architecture — the muddy midtones were the FN base cells (never binary before), not the emboss. Reorder to FN->Mosaic->Posterize(2)->Emboss->Tint: Posterize binarizes the BASE to pure black/white FIRST, so the ONLY non-binary values entering Tint are the emboss lips at edges. No posterize after => Tint maps continuously: pure navy/cream cells + grey lips => navy-cream mid densities = tactile relief. Resolves strict-two-tone AND visible-relief simultaneously.
